w.name: Blueprint | Agents cannot see the blueprint's flow and transition conditions from a ticket
w.description_html:
Summary

On a ticket inside a blueprint, Desk only shows the current state and the transition buttons available right now. Agents cannot open the whole blueprint to see which states come next, which transition leads where, and what each transition needs before its button appears. TAVI CRM already has this on its records: the "View configured actions" link in the Blueprint section opens a popup with this flow.

Steps to Reproduce

  1. In TAVI CRM, open a lead that is in a blueprint (for example AEX-01-BP, blueprint AEO-01).

  2. In the Blueprint section, click View configured actions. A popup shows each state, the transition between states and the condition, for example web → WebToReferral → referral, "Shown when: Company is not empty".

  3. In TAVI Desk, open a ticket that is in an active blueprint.

  4. Look for the same option on the ticket's blueprint card.

Expected Result

  • The Desk ticket's blueprint card has a "View configured actions" option, the same as CRM.

  • It opens the blueprint's flow: states, the transitions between them and each transition's "Shown when" condition.

  • An agent can then see why a transition button is not showing yet and what has to be filled in first.

Actual Result

  • The Desk ticket only shows the current state and the transitions available right now.

  • If no transition is available, the agent has no way of finding out which condition is missing.

  • The blueprint flow can only be seen in Settings → Blueprints, which agents normally cannot open.

Note

Compared with TAVI CRM, which runs on the same blueprint engine. Zoho Desk was not checked live. Not part of the Desk blueprint gap list NDC-2754.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging) and staging-crm.taviportal.com, Microsoft Edge, Windows 10, 15 Nov 2026.

Attachment

Screenshot of the TAVI CRM "View configured actions" popup for blueprint AEO-01 (crm-view-configured-actions.png).

L.comment_stripped:
Reproduced on staging: the ticket's blueprint card had no "View configured actions".
Fix on client-engine fix/ndc-3056-3034-3032-ticket-blueprint: the ticket's Steps card, and the "No transitions you can run" line, now offer "View configured actions". It opens the same flow as CRM (states, transitions, each "Shown when" condition, current state highlighted) and lists the steps from the current state: whether you can run each one now, whether it runs by itself, and what it asks for. When nothing can run, the card says a step may be waiting for its conditions or limited to its owners.
Checked in a browser on the branch build against staging's real data: a step with "Shown when: Priority = high" on a low-priority ticket showed the condition and "You can't run this step now". Light and dark theme and Arabic checked. Not deployed yet.

L.comment_stripped:
Retest 16 Nov 2026 — FAIL (partial), moved back to Bug
NDC-Staging, ticket #4164 in blueprint "test blueprint" (Tech), Edge. Recording: https://jam.dev/c/09208a61-3455-4a9c-8b64-c37c5b32a7e6
What works now
While no transition can be run, the ticket header shows "No transitions you can run · View configured actions", and the Steps card in Ticket Properties has the same link.
The popup shows the blueprint flow: each transition from the current state, where it leads, its "Shown when" condition (for example Move to On Hold, Shown when Sub Category = "refund"), and why each step can't be run yet.
What still fails
Sub Category was set to Refund and saved, so "Move to On Hold" can now be run. The header then shows only the "Move to On Hold" button, and the "View configured actions" link is gone.
The link stays only in the Steps card. With Ticket Properties closed, there is no way to open the flow view from the ticket.
Expected
"View configured actions" stays in the ticket header at all times while the ticket is in a blueprint, next to any transition buttons. Agents still need the flow when a transition is available, for example to see what comes after On Hold or why Closed and Reopened are not offered.
Note
The server still returns the full flow after the change: blueprint-state returns allStates, and allTransitions with their conditions. Only the header stops showing the link.
Annotated evidence attached: NDC-3056-retest-FAIL.png. Boxes 1–3 PASS; box 4 and box 6 FAIL; box 5 is the Steps card link that still works.

L.comment_stripped:
Fixed and live on tavi (client-engine #855, desk-web deployed 17 Nov 2026). Moving to Ready For Test.
The ticket's "View configured actions" now shows the whole blueprint. It lists every state and every transition between them, each with its "Shown when" condition. The current state's steps come first and are highlighted, and the other states' steps follow in the blueprint's order. Below the flow, the list of steps from the current state still says whether you can run each one and what it asks for.
Checked in the browser on staging (NDC-Staging), with a temporary blueprint with four states and five steps: Open → On Hold (shown when Priority = high), Open → Escalated, Open → Closed, On Hold → Closed and Escalated → Closed. The ticket was at Open.
Before this deploy, the popup showed 3 of the 5 steps (Open's).
Now it shows all 5: Open's three first, then On Hold → Closed and Escalated → Closed, with "Shown when: Priority = high" under the first.
Checked in English with the light theme at 1440 px, in Arabic with the dark theme at 1440 px (arrows run right to left), and in English with the dark theme at 1024 px. Nothing overflows.
A note on CRM: CRM's popup still shows only the current state's steps, as before. CRM's record page shows the whole chain in its blueprint strip, and a ticket has no such strip, so the Desk popup now shows it instead.
The temporary blueprint and ticket are deleted.
